mapper.sql: id, project_id, object_id, clause_ref, judgment, evidence, rule_hits_json, rationale, remediation, missing_info_json, source, llm_call_id, reviewed, reviewer_note, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at, dim_d, dim_a, dim_k, ra, rk, module_level
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assess_finding WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY object_id, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assess_finding (project_id, object_id, clause_ref, judgment, evidence, rule_hits_json, rationale, remediation, missing_info_json, source, llm_call_id, reviewed, created_at, updated_at, dim_d, dim_a, dim_k, ra, rk, module_level) VALUES (#{f.projectId}, #{f.objectId}, #{f.clauseRef}, #{f.judgment}, #{f.evidence}, #{f.ruleHitsJson}, #{f.rationale}, #{f.remediation}, #{f.missingInfoJson}, #{f.source}, #{f.llmCallId}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{f.dimD}, #{f.dimA}, #{f.dimK}, #{f.ra}, #{f.rk}, #{f.moduleLevel}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE judgment = VALUES(judgment), evidence = VALUES(evidence), rule_hits_json = VALUES(rule_hits_json), rationale = VALUES(rationale), remediation = VALUES(remediation), missing_info_json = VALUES(missing_info_json), source = VALUES(source), llm_call_id = VALUES(llm_call_id), dim_d = VALUES(dim_d), dim_a = VALUES(dim_a), dim_k = VALUES(dim_k), ra = VALUES(ra), rk = VALUES(rk), module_level = VALUES(module_level), reviewed = FALSE, reviewer_note = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE assess_finding SET judgment = #{judgment}, reviewer_note = #{note}, reviewed = #{reviewed}, source = #{source}, dim_d = #{d}, dim_a = #{a}, dim_k = #{k}, ra = #{ra}, rk = #{rk}, reviewed_at = CASE WHEN #{reviewed} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assess_finding WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND reviewed = FALSE
